transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I… I’ve been feeling like everything is my fault. My friend died, and I didn’t call her back. I had bad thoughts sometimes, ugly thoughts, and… I keep telling people I’m the reason it happened. Like the Lord is punishing everyone at church because of me.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or blaming yourself for things more than usual?
Yes… more than usual. I keep thinking it’s on me, what happened to my friend. I didn’t call her back, and I had… ugly thoughts sometimes. I know the Lord is punishing people at church because of me.
Have you ever experienced times where you felt so energetic or wired that you didn’t need much sleep, even if just for a few nights?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t had anything like that, not really.
How long have you been feeling this way, blaming yourself and thinking that the Lord is punishing others because of you?
About… two months, I think. Since my close friend died. It’s been there since then.
Have you had other times in your life when you felt down, hopeless, or blamed yourself like this before?

Not… not like this. I’ve felt bad before, I guess, but this is different. I keep telling them it’s my fault my friend died… because I didn’t call her back, and because of the thoughts I had. And… I know people at church are being punished because of me.
Have you ever had other periods in your life where you felt this level of guilt, hopelessness, or depression before this happened with your friend?
No… not like this before. It’s been about two months now, since my friend died.
Before this happened with your friend, have you ever had any other times in your life when you felt so down, hopeless, or guilty that it interfered with your daily life?
I don’t think so… I mean, I’ve had hard days before, but nothing that took over like this.
Before this current time, have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
No… I don’t think so. Not for two weeks like that, before all this.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period where you felt so down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
No… I don’t think I’ve had that before. Not like this, anyway.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
I… I don’t think so. I know I already said that, but before this, no, not for that long.

Have you ever had any other times in your life, even before this happened with your friend, where you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things for a while—maybe not as severe as this, but still noticeable?
Not really… I mean, everyone has bad days, I guess. But nothing I’d call a real spell of it before this.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things for several days in a row—even if not as long or as severe as this time?
I don’t really think so… maybe a bad day here or there, but not several days where I was like this. Not that I can remember.
